metadata.description:
From Fold to Consciousness, version 1.0.0, reports the current-evidence-closed, extension-open foundational Consciousness and Cognitive Science branch of the Smithian Fold Theory V3 clean-room reconstruction.

The release contains 72 engine-admitted laws across 12 ordered families. Their 18,432 exact candidates yield 72 unique survivors, 288 passing adverse controls, 72 implementation-distinct reconstructions and 72 post-seal empirical-boundary comparisons. Every dependency graph reaches There Is No Nothing; the branch uses zero axioms, zero free or fitted parameters, exact positive-finite Fold arithmetic and no target-selected or opaque predictor.

Headline results derive observation and interior observation, the access-report-presence boundary, binding and unity, subject and perspective, introspection loss, memory and identity continuity, finite self-model limits, attention, cognition, substrate-independent realization conditions, qualia differentiation and resonance, and the complete red-of-red self-reidentification law. Exact constructions include the one-quarter/three-quarters observer partition, the one-quarter to one-half to One self-model closure, the one-third/two-thirds memory return, and the one-seventh/two-sevenths/four-sevenths period-three qualitative support.

The complete V1/V2 ownership audit reviews 763 prior entries and closes all 46 Consciousness-owned atomic questions, including the stronger qualia-resonance and red-of-red obligations. Fifteen preregistered external source identities contribute 61 features: 58 are present, three absent features and 18 failed transport or content rows remain preserved. The bundle will provide PDF and Markdown papers, frozen inventory, derivation audit, claim packages, external evidence records, engine receipts and checksums.
